messages:
Maya Patel: FYI hitting a weird hang in the Go quickstart generator sample when cancelling streams with context. Repro: start stream, cancel parent ctx after ~200ms, goroutine count climbs and app doesn't exit cleanly.

Maya Patel: Minimal snippet from sample app:
`````
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 150*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Generator.Stream(ctx, model, opts)
for stream.Next() {
  fmt.Println(stream.Token())
}
if err := stream.Err(); err != nil {
  log.Println("stream error:", err)
}
`````

Maya Patel: Expected stream stops on ctx cancel. Actual: stream.Next() sometimes blocks indefinitely in tests.

Chris Nguyen: Two quick suspects: transport not using req.WithContext, or an auth token refresher goroutine ignoring ctx. Does sample helper spawn a refresher?

Maya Patel: Yes, devex helper has a tiny autofetcher that starts a goroutine to refresh on 401.

Sasha Ivanov: If retry/backoff loop does plain time.Sleep without checking ctx.Done() you'll leak goroutines.

Priyanka Rao: Also check generator.Stream's reader - if the io.Reader isn't closed on ctx cancel, Next() blocks. Runtime should use req = req.WithContext(ctx) so transport cancels system call.

Chris Nguyen: Quick grep: http.NewRequest(...) then go doRetry(req) that spawns attempts writing to a channel without select on ctx.Done(). Cancelling the ctx leaves those goroutines sleeping.

Alex Gomez: Reproduced locally, pprof shows goroutines in time.Sleep in retry loop. Gist attached: https://gist.github.com/xxx/quickstart-stream-ctx-leak

Priyanka Rao: Fix plan: 1) ensure all http requests use req = req.WithContext(ctx) 2) make retry/backoff ctx-aware with select on ctx.Done() 3) ensure stream.Next returns on cancel by wiring transport cancellation into reader.

Sasha Ivanov: SDK ergonomics note: generator streaming API should document both ctx usage and provide a Close/Cancel on the returned Stream to make cancellation explicit in examples.

Chris Nguyen: Also consider auth retry behavior: long background retries are okay for unary calls but for streaming we should fail fast on ctx cancel or offer per-call option to allow long retries.

Priyanka Rao: Add quickstart README note: "Generator streaming honors ctx cancellation; sample helper's background refresh can keep app alive—disable for demos."

Alex Gomez: I'll open a PR with small commits: respect ctx in retry/backoff, use req.WithContext for transport, docs update and add stream.Close demo. ETA EOD tomorrow.

devex-bot: CI queued (quickstart-tests) job #4921

Maya Patel: Thanks, Alex — once PR is up I'll run mac/linux quickstart CI.

Chris Nguyen: Long-term: add e2e smoke test asserting goroutine baseline after quickstart cancellation, and add lint to catch missing WithContext in transport helper.

Priyanka Rao: Agreed, lint/codegen check + ctx-aware sleep helper in examples to avoid hiding bugs.

Alex Gomez: Linking work to GH issue #789 when PR lands. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Good catch everyone — this was blocking a customer demo onboarding.
